summary: Implemented the approved Clinical Glass launch experience using generated OpenAPI types and the Railway API, including truthful read-only SMS/voice provider evidence, minimized role projections, complete async and recovery states, responsive accessibility, and Railway Vite SPA readiness; removed the obsolete browser-local workflow UI and dependencies.

commands: secret-name scan of frontend production output
python3 scripts/agentctl.py scope check LAUNCH-001 frontend
tests.notes: The generated OpenAPI client is current. TypeScript and the Vite production build pass. Seven focused Vitest checks pass for provider evidence, activation-held channels, pricing, route mapping, and the continuity field. Five Chromium journeys pass for the public 320px surface, activation-held communications, verified versus outcome-unknown provider evidence, revoked caregiver privacy, dialog focus/Escape behavior, reduced motion, 390px header target size, and horizontal overflow. A Railway-shaped build proved that VITE_API_BASE_URL is embedded as the public API origin while scenario/operator/provider/database secret names are absent from the production output. npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities. Visual review passed for the provider workspace at 1440px and 390px; the mobile header was corrected to compact icon controls with 44px targets.

notes_for_next_agent: The anonymous browser client consumes only contract-declared public fixed-scenario operations. It contains no scenario/operator credential and exposes no reset, SMS initiation, or voice initiation control; those operations remain operator-only.

The staff SMS and voice surface renders persisted projection evidence only. Empty channels say No attempt and keep live-send controls disabled; queued is not delivered, answered is not completed, provider-unavailable remains unresolved, outcome-unknown disables blind resend, and reconciled/provider-callback provenance is explicit.
The public landing contains no patient record, MRN, regimen, facility record, readiness graph, or workspace preview. Pricing is centralized in frontend/src/launch/config.ts.

Caregiver rendering consumes only the minimized caregiver projection and mounts a privacy-locked state when transport permission is false; prior logistics and clinical content are absent rather than hidden.

Railway web setup is frontend-owned through frontend/railway.toml plus frontend/Staticfile. Configure the service root as /frontend, config file path as /frontend/railway.toml, and VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://${{api.RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN}}; no deploy was performed.

The obsolete browser-local reducer/UI stack and unused frontend dependencies were removed. Active frontend CSS fell from 1,852 lines to 324 lines, the production CSS bundle fell from about 91 kB to 35 kB, and the branch removes more than 8,000 stale source lines.
The remaining public JPEGs are retained tracked assets from the prior visual system; they are not imported or shipped by the current Vite build and do not affect agent text context.
